posts.author: Xipinjin
posts.body:
Hi,
I'm looking for a world map concept inspired by the level selection screen of Slay the Spire and Void Bastards :
So, the idea is : The player interacts with a computer on starship wich opens a level selection map. The player starts from a point and then choose between 2 or more possible destinations. The destinations are pre construct levels but the order of destination choices is randomly attributed.
The world map should also show infos on the possible destinations before the player confirms the travel.
I don't know if there's a plugin for that but I didn't find any so it would be really helpful if you know one or more.
Thanks.

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
You could easily do this through eventing.
The "map screen" itself would be a new map in game.
Then you could lay out events on the map at locations and have a parallel event watch for player inputs. When they press a direction, it would move the player character to the next event. You'd need to swap the player character image with something like a cursor.
You could probably even skip the parallel event. If it's fixed routes, then you could just put a player-touch event and when the player pushes a direction that moves towards that event, it would trigger a move route to complete the remainder of the route.
I imagine this might look closer to something like Super Mario World's map and how it functions:
